name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Scratch Buttermilk Biscuits with Seedless Boysenberry Jam
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: World-famous scratch-baked buttermilk biscuits served warm with butter and Knott's seedless boysenberry jam. Pillowy, comforting, and completely seed-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask specifically for Knott's 'Seedless Boysenberry Jam' or pure honey to spread on your warm biscuit.
watchOuts: Verify you are served the Seedless Boysenberry Jam, not whole preserves with seeds
